title: I4: Add eight short JNR quality procedures for review
public_pr_body:
Adds eight short procedures for records, order review, suppliers, production/traceability, nonconformance/corrective action, internal audit, management review and competence. Reflects existing supplier/inspection/problem controls and their limits. Each is 358–408 words, with owner, steps and evidence fields; printed layout must be checked before issue.

Tolra supports JNR’s quality work. Software/documents cannot certify JNR; JNR is audited.

- [x] Source review and git diff --check; documentation only.
- [ ] John appoints owners, reviews/adopts controls and supplies real evidence.

Builder 5 claim claims/I4. Independent draft on main 68f89ca7; all files under docs/iso9001/. Builders 3 and 4 untouched. No runtime validation, main merge, Ready label, production SQL, deployment or new feature. Handover: docs/iso9001/BUILDER-5-HANDOVER.md on I7.
